item.title: Expertise and Capabilities in Customized Grinding Machine Manufacturing
item.description:
Expertise and Capabilities in Customized Grinding Machine Manufacturing
#

Comork brings over two decades of accumulated grinding technology and experience, focusing on delivering stable, accurate, and precise OEM/ODM grinding machines tailored to diverse customer requirements. Our CNC internal and external cylindrical grinders integrate both functions, enabling multi-sided grinding with a single clamping, streamlining processes and enhancing efficiency.

item.title: Precision and Capability in In-House Machining and Inspection
item.description:
Precision and Capability in In-House Machining and Inspection
#

COMORK builds on over two decades of CCM’s grinding technology and experience, emphasizing both quality and efficiency in every aspect of production. Unlike many small and medium-sized factories that focus solely on assembly, COMORK takes a comprehensive approach: approximately 80% of the company’s machine and spindle parts and accessories are manufactured in-house. This strategy ensures tight control over both accuracy and delivery schedules.
